Þetta er músin og spjaldið — smellur sem lendir á *heims*hniti, lifandi talning við hlið myndarinnar og einn hnappur sem skrifar út smellina sjálfa en ekki heildartöluna.

records.context: A counting session is thousands of clicks and a proportion of them are wrong. The two ways of correcting a mistake are different actions: **undo** takes back the last thing you did, and **clicking a marker again** takes back a specific thing you did some time ago. Both are here, and clicking a marker removes it whatever class it was scored as — a counter who has to re-select the class before they can take a marker back will leave the wrong marker there.
records.label: spacr.qt.counting_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A counting session is thousands of clicks and a proportion of them are wrong. The two ways of correcting a mistake are different actions: **undo** takes back the last thing you did, and **clicking a marker again** takes back a specific thing you did some time ago. Both are here, and clicking a marker removes it whatever class it was scored as — a counter who has to re-select the class before they can take a marker back will leave the wrong marker there.
records.translation: Talningarlota er þúsundir smella og hluti þeirra er rangur. Tvær leiðir til að leiðrétta mistök eru ólíkar aðgerðir: **afturköllun** tekur til baka það síðasta sem þú gerðir, og **annar smellur á merki** tekur til baka tiltekna aðgerð sem þú gerðir fyrir nokkru. Hvort tveggja er hér, og smellur á merki fjarlægir það óháð því í hvaða flokk það var skráð — sá sem telur og þarf að velja flokkinn aftur áður en hann getur tekið merki til baka mun skilja ranga merkið eftir.

records.source: Why the side panels are not one pixel per slice
records.translation: Hvers vegna hliðarspjöldin eru ekki einn pixill á sneið

records.context: Because a confocal stack is not isotropic. 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack, and a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin — a picture that does not look broken, just slightly flat, and every 3-D shape read off it is wrong. :meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` gives all three panels one world-units-per-pixel scale, so this module never divides anything by a slice count.
records.label: spacr.qt.ortho_view#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Because a confocal stack is not isotropic. 0.65 µm in xy and 2 µm in z is an ordinary spaCR stack, and a side view drawn one pixel per slice is three times too thin — a picture that does not look broken, just slightly flat, and every 3-D shape read off it is wrong. :meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` gives all three panels one world-units-per-pixel scale, so this module never divides anything by a slice count.
records.translation: Vegna þess að confocal-stafli er ekki jafnáttaður. 0.65 µm í xy og 2 µm í z er venjulegur spaCR-stafli, og hliðarsýn sem teiknuð er með einum pixli á sneið er þrisvar sinnum of mjó — mynd sem lítur ekki út fyrir að vera biluð, bara örlítið flöt, og hvert þrívítt form sem lesið er af henni er rangt. :meth:`spacr.layers.OrthoViews.covering` gefur öllum þremur spjöldunum einn kvarða heimseininga á pixil, svo þessi eining deilir aldrei neinu með sneiðafjölda.

records.context: Users often have 5–20 plates to segment, measure, or classify with the same settings. This module executes them one after another instead of one at a time from the Mask app. It lets users:
records.label: spacr.qt.plate_queue#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Users often have 5–20 plates to segment, measure, or classify with the same settings. This module runs them one after another instead of one at a time from the Mask app. It lets users:
records.translation: Notendur hafa oft 5–20 plötur til að hluta, mæla eða flokka með sömu stillingum. Þessi eining keyrir þær hverja á eftir annarri í stað þess að þær séu keyrðar ein í einu úr Mask-forritinu. Hún gerir notendum kleift að:

records.context: 1. Enqueue a plate as ``(app_key, settings)`` (or import a batch of plates from a CSV). 2. Execute the software job list in the background — one item at a time — and see per-item status update live. 3. Pause between items, or stop cold. 4. Have every completed item show up in the processing-session journal history like a normal invocation, so nothing about downstream tooling changes.
records.label: spacr.qt.plate_queue#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. Enqueue a plate as ``(app_key, settings)`` (or import a batch of plates from a CSV). 2. Run the queue in the background — one item at a time — and see per-item status update live. 3. Pause between items, or stop cold. 4. Have every completed item show up in the run-journal history like a normal invocation, so nothing about downstream tooling changes.
records.translation: 1. Setja plötu í biðröð sem ``(app_key, settings)`` (eða flytja inn runu af plötum úr CSV). 2. Keyra biðröðina í bakgrunni — eitt atriði í einu — og sjá stöðu hvers atriðis uppfærast jafnóðum. 3. Gera hlé milli atriða eða stöðva samstundis. 4. Láta hvert lokið atriði birtast í ferli keyrsludagbókarinnar eins og venjulegt kall, svo ekkert breytist í tólum sem nota niðurstöðurnar.

records.context: **The segmentation verdict.**  :mod:`spacr.seg_qc` scores every mask the moment it is written and files ``<plate>/qc/segmentation_qc_<object>.csv``. records.source: **The segmentation verdict.**  :mod:`spacr.seg_qc` scores every mask the moment it is written and files ``<plate>/qc/segmentation_qc_<object>.csv``.  Measure then spends hours cropping and measuring those masks without anyone having read it.  The banner this module puts on the Measure screen reads that card back and says what it says, naming the plate, the wells and the likely cause — a verdict a user can act on, not a count of failures.
records.translation: **Úrskurðurinn um hlutun.**  :mod:`spacr.seg_qc` metur hverja grímu um leið og hún er skrifuð og vistar ``<plate>/qc/segmentation_qc_<object>.csv``.  Measure eyðir síðan klukkustundum í að skera og mæla þessar grímur án þess að nokkur hafi lesið hana.  Borðinn sem þessi eining setur á Measure-skjáinn les það spjald til baka og segir hvað stendur á því, og nefnir plötuna, brunnana og líklegu orsökina — úrskurður sem notandi getur brugðist við, ekki fjöldi villna.

records.context: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The diameter.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` measures characteristic object size from a handful of the user's own fields, without loading Cellpose or torch. ``diameter`` is the single most consequential Cellpose 4 setting spaCR exposes — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` rescales every image by ``30/diameter`` so objects land near the size ``cpsam`` works at — and it is the one users guess at.  The panel this module builds replaces the guess with a measurement, per object type, and shows how many objects it measured so the estimate can be judged.  It opens in a popup of its own from the *Measure diameters…* button in Mask generation's Model zoo popup, next to the choice of model it is the other half of, rather than on the main screen.
records.translation: **Þvermálið.**  :mod:`spacr.diameter` mælir einkennandi stærð hluta út frá nokkrum af sjónsviðum notandans sjálfs, án þess að hlaða Cellpose eða torch. ``diameter`` er sú stilling Cellpose 4 sem spaCR birtir sem hefur langmestar afleiðingar — ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` endurkvarðar hverja mynd um ``30/diameter`` svo hlutir lendi nálægt þeirri stærð sem ``cpsam`` vinnur við — og það er sú sem notendur giska á.  Spjaldið sem þessi eining byggir kemur í stað ágiskunarinnar með mælingu, fyrir hverja hlutagerð, og sýnir hve marga hluti það mældi svo hægt sé að meta matið.  Það opnast í eigin sprettiglugga frá hnappnum *Measure diameters…* í Model zoo sprettiglugga Mask generation, við hlið líkanavalsins sem það er hinn helmingurinn af, en ekki á aðalskjánum.

records.translation: ``CellposeModel.eval(diameter=...)`` undir Cellpose 4 endurkvarðar inntakið um ``30/diameter`` svo hlutir lendi nálægt þeirri stærð sem ``cpsam`` vinnur við, sem gerir tvöfalda skekkju í þessari einu tölu að tvöfaldri skekkju í hverri grímu, talningu og mælingu sem á eftir kemur. :mod:`spacr.diameter` mælir hana út frá nokkrum úrtakssjónsviðum — enginn Cellpose, ekkert torch — og þetta spjald er þar sem sú mæling nær inn í stillingaformið.

records.source: The work is split in two so that no filesystem call runs on the GUI thread. What stays here is widget state — the ``src`` field, and whether it names anything — and it is free. What moved into :meth:`_refresh_job` is every filesystem call: ``find_scorecards`` walking the user's plate folders, one ``os.stat`` per card, and ``read_digest`` opening and parsing the CSVs. All of it is I/O on a path the user supplied.
records.translation: Verkinu er skipt í tvennt svo að ekkert skráarkerfiskall keyri á GUI-þræðinum. Það sem verður eftir hér er staða viðmótshluta — ``src`` reiturinn og hvort hann nefnir eitthvað — og það kostar ekkert. Það sem fluttist í :meth:`_refresh_job` er hvert skráarkerfiskall: ``find_scorecards`` sem fer um plötumöppur notandans, eitt ``os.stat`` fyrir hvert spjald, og ``read_digest`` sem opnar og þáttar CSV-skrárnar. Allt er þetta I/O á slóð sem notandinn gaf upp.

records.context: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.translation: Mælt á einni vinnustöð: ``os.path.exists`` á slóð undir ``/nas_mnt`` — ``autofs`` tengipunktur þar sem samnýtta drifið var í dvala — hafði ekki skilað eftir tuttugu sekúndur, því stat-kallið er það sem kveikir á sjálfvirku tengingunni. Þessi aðferð vann áður það verk beint og ``install_qc_banner`` kallaði áður á hana inni í ``MainWindow._build_screen``, svo allt viðmótið fraus við hverja opnun Measure. Það skildi ekki eftir neina villurakningu, því stöðvuð atburðalykkja er ekki hrun; tilkynnt var um það sem "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", ásamt flökti við bendilsveimi og leiftrum af öðrum skjám.

records.context: The banner keeps whatever it last drew while a read is in flight. There is deliberately no :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` gate in front of the job: the probe answers ``isdir`` optimistically-cheap but the scan has to happen off the GUI thread regardless, so a gate would only add a first-visit blank for no protection this does not give.
records.translation: Borðinn heldur því sem hann teiknaði síðast meðan lestur stendur yfir. Viljandi er engin :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` sía fyrir framan verkið: prófunin svarar ``isdir`` bjartsýnt og ódýrt, en skönnunin þarf hvort sem er að fara fram utan GUI-þráðarins, svo sía myndi aðeins bæta við auðri mynd við fyrstu heimsókn án nokkurrar verndar sem þetta veitir ekki.

records.source: One :class:`_ConsoleForwarder` handler is added to the root ``spacr`` logger. Its emit() hands the formatted line to :class:`_ConsoleRelay`, which delivers it to whatever ConsolePanel is registered via :func:`register_console_target`.
records.translation: Einum :class:`_ConsoleForwarder` meðhöndlara er bætt við rótarskráarann ``spacr``. emit() hans afhendir sniðnu línuna :class:`_ConsoleRelay`, sem kemur henni til þess ConsolePanel sem er skráð með :func:`register_console_target`.

records.context: ``emit()`` executes on **whatever independent execution path logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the main GUI execution path. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a background execution unit; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download independent execution path.
records.label: spacr.qt.verbose_logger#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``emit()`` runs on **whatever thread logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the GUI thread. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a worker thread; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download thread.
records.translation: ``emit()`` keyrir á **þeim þræði sem skráði færsluna** — logging-eining Python kallar beint á meðhöndlara. ConsolePanel svarar ``append_stdout`` með því að *smíða QWidgets* (efnisstiku og textablokk), og Qt bannar að QWidget sé smíðaður annars staðar en á GUI-þræðinum. Bein köll á spjaldið úr ``emit()`` smíðuðu því viðmótshluta á vinnuþræði; Qt prentaði ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` og felldi síðan ferlið. Hægt var að endurtaka þetta úr :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, en undantekningarleið hennar skráir viðvörun innan úr niðurhalsþræðinum.

records.context: The structured-data name is the frame's *identity*, not its contents: a subset has fewer rows and can genuinely classify differently, so re-deriving for a filtered frame is correct rather than wasteful. ``id()`` alone would be unsound because CPython reuses addresses, so the entry also holds a ``weakref`` and the hit is confirmed with ``is`` — a collected frame cannot produce a false hit, because its weakref resolves to ``None``. The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.

The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.
records.translation: Lykillinn er *auðkenni* töflunnar, ekki innihald hennar: hlutmengi hefur færri línur og getur í raun flokkast öðruvísi, svo það er rétt en ekki sóun að leiða flokkunina aftur út fyrir síaða töflu. ``id()`` eitt og sér væri ótraust því CPython endurnýtir minnisföng, svo færslan geymir líka ``weakref`` og samsvörun er staðfest með ``is`` — tafla sem hefur verið hreinsuð úr minni getur ekki gefið falska samsvörun, því weakref hennar leysist í ``None``. Lögunin er líka athuguð, því hægt er að breyta töflu á staðnum.

records.context: The one subtlety is the click that lands *on the button* while the popover is open. Qt sends that press to the popup, closes the popup because the press was outside it, and then replays the press at the widget underneath — which is the button, which toggles straight back on. One click, open-close-open, and the popover looks like it will not close. :data:`REOPEN_GUARD_MS` is the window in which the replayed half of that click is ignored.

records.context: The theme draws every ``QProgressBar`` as an 8 px track (``height: 8px; max-height: 8px`` in :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`). A bar that also paints its own text -- "step 2 of 3", "45%", "312 MB / 690 MB (45%)" -- draws a 13 px caption into those 8 px, so only the top half of each glyph reaches the application view, and at 50 % GUI scale the track is 4 px and almost nothing does. A caption such as "step 1 of 3" or "10%" is cut off.
records.translation: Þemað teiknar hverja ``QProgressBar`` sem 8 px braut (``height: 8px; max-height: 8px`` í :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`). records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Design rules
records.translation: Hönnunarreglur

records.context: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.translation: **Hann sannreynir meðan þú slærð inn, ekki þegar þú staðfestir.** Segðin er þáttuð við hvern áslátt (þáttun fjörutíu stafa strengs tekur míkrósekúndur), svo villuboðin fyrir ``area / perimter`` birtast við innsláttarvilluna en ekki eftir Add sem virðist ekki gera neitt. Add-hnappurinn er óvirkur þar til formúlan þáttast *og* finnst í hlaðinni töflu.

records.context: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.translation: **Hann sýnir gildin, ekki bara málskipanina.** Formúla getur verið fullkomlega gild og framleitt dálk sem er 90% óendanleg gildi, sem engin málskipunarathugun grípur. Forskoðunin reiknar segðina yfir upphaf töflunnar og prentar :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — svo slæmur hlutfallsdálkur uppgötvast áður en hann nær í graf.

records.context: **It hands back a frame, not a mutation.** :meth:`FormulaPanel.computed_frame` returns the loaded table *plus* the computed columns, a copy every time. The loaded frame is never grown, so removing a formula removes its column, and two application views showing the same table do not accumulate each other's columns.

records.source: Browse the model zoo, download a model, and hand back its path.
records.translation: Skoðar líkanasafnið, sækir líkan og skilar slóð þess.

records.context: A model setting takes a filesystem path, so the user has to know a model exists, find where it lives, and type it correctly. This dialog lists the models in spaCR's catalogue, what each was trained on, whether it is already on this machine, and a button that downloads one and returns its path to the field that opened it.

This dialog lists the models in spaCR's catalogue, what each was trained on, whether it is already on this machine, and a button that downloads one and returns its path to the field that opened it.
records.translation: Líkanastilling tekur slóð í skráarkerfinu, svo notandinn þarf að vita að líkan sé til, finna hvar það er og slá það rétt inn. Þessi gluggi telur upp líkönin í skrá spaCR, á hverju hvert þeirra var þjálfað, hvort það er þegar á þessari tölvu, og hnapp sem sækir líkan og skilar slóð þess í reitinn sem opnaði gluggann.

records.context: The download location is a control rather than a constant. Checkpoints are large -- the Toxoplasma models are 1.2 GB each -- and on a shared workstation or a laptop with a small root volume the default is often the wrong disk. A lab that keeps models on a NAS wants them there once, not once per user. So the folder is on application view, remembered between openings, and shown before anything is fetched rather than discovered afterwards in a full-disk error.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The download location is a control rather than a constant. Checkpoints are large -- the Toxoplasma models are 1.2 GB each -- and on a shared workstation or a laptop with a small root volume the default is often the wrong disk. A lab that keeps models on a NAS wants them there once, not once per user. So the folder is on screen, remembered between openings, and shown before anything is fetched rather than discovered afterwards in a full-disk error.
records.translation: Niðurhalsstaðurinn er stýring en ekki fasti. Vistunarpunktar eru stórir -- Toxoplasma-líkönin eru 1.2 GB hvert -- og á sameiginlegri vinnustöð eða fartölvu með litlu rótardrifi er sjálfgefni staðurinn oft rangur diskur. Rannsóknarstofa sem geymir líkön á NAS vill hafa þau þar einu sinni, ekki einu sinni á hvern notanda. Mappan er því á skjánum, munað á milli opnana, og sýnd áður en nokkuð er sótt í stað þess að uppgötvast eftir á í villu um fullan disk.

records.context: Nothing is downloaded until requested. Opening the dialog lists the models; the download happens on the button. The list is useful on its own -- whether a model exists and what it was trained on -- and opening the dialog does not start a gigabyte transfer.

records.context: The list has five source headings rather than one checkbox. The catalogue has five origins -- models trained here, the stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's models and a shared community catalogue -- and each can be shown or hidden. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on application view and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. A warning is shown before the first unvetted community row -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.

A warning is shown before the first unvetted community row -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.translation: Listinn hefur fimm upprunafyrirsagnir í stað eins gátreits. Skráin á sér fimm uppruna -- líkön þjálfuð hér, stöðluðu Cellpose-SAM grunnnetin, safn bioimage.io, líkön Cellpose 3 bakendans og sameiginlega samfélagsskrá -- og hvern þeirra má sýna eða fela. :class:`SourceStrip` eru upprunarnir fimm sem fimm smellanleg heiti, hvert blátt þegar línur þess eru á skjánum og deyft þegar þær eru felldar saman, og munað á milli opnana. Viðvörun birtist á undan fyrstu óyfirfarnu samfélagslínunni -- sjá :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.

records.context: The dialog states what it changes before it changes it. A backend installs into an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends``; spaCR's own environment is never touched, so nothing here can stop spaCR starting. The dialog says where it goes, what it downloads, how large it is and under what licence before Install is pressed.

records.source: The dialog states what it changes before it changes it. A backend installs into an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends``; spaCR's own environment is never touched, so nothing here can stop spaCR starting. The dialog says where it goes, what it downloads, how large it is and under what licence before Install is pressed.
records.translation: Glugginn segir hverju hann breytir áður en hann breytir því. Bakendi er settur upp í eigið umhverfi undir ``~/.spacr/backends``; eigið umhverfi spaCR er aldrei snert, svo ekkert hér getur komið í veg fyrir að spaCR ræsist. records.source: Everything this widget offers the user comes out of a measurements database, and both reads used to happen on the GUI thread:
records.translation: Allt sem þessi viðmótshluti býður notandanum kemur úr mælingagagnagrunni, og báðir lestrarnir fóru áður fram á GUI-þræðinum:

records.context: ``discover_columns`` opens every database the ``src`` setting resolves to and runs ``sqlite_master`` plus a ``PRAGMA table_info`` per table. It is driven from ``SettingsWidgets._refresh_contextual_widgets``, so it executes every time ``src`` or ``tables`` is set.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion#2

records.source: ``discover_columns`` opens every database the ``src`` setting resolves to and runs ``sqlite_master`` plus a ``PRAGMA table_info`` per table. It is driven from ``SettingsWidgets._refresh_contextual_widgets``, so it runs every time ``src`` or ``tables`` is set.
records.translation: ``discover_columns`` opnar hvern gagnagrunn sem ``src`` stillingin leysist í og keyrir ``sqlite_master`` auk ``PRAGMA table_info`` fyrir hverja töflu. Því er stýrt frá ``SettingsWidgets._refresh_contextual_widgets``, svo það keyrir í hvert sinn sem ``src`` eða ``tables`` er stillt.

records.context: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. With worker execution, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. Threaded, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.translation: ``distinct_values`` keyrir eitt ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` fyrir hvert ``(database, table)`` par sem valinn dálkur birtist í — og dálkarnir sem notendur útiloka í raun eftir (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hafa örfá ólík gildi yfir alla töfluna, svo LIMIT næst aldrei og SQLite skannar hverja línu. Mælt á 200 000 línu × 8 töflu measurements.db með heitt síðuskyndiminni: **196 ms á dálk**, og dálkafellilistinn er breytanlegur, svo ``currentTextChanged`` fer af stað við hvern áslátt. Átta hraðar breytingar frystu gluggann í **894 ms** í einni samfelldri lotu; ``set_source`` sjálft kostaði 183 ms og eitt yfirvegað dálkaval 220 ms. Á þráðum taka sömu þrjár aðgerðir 29 ms, 5 ms og 2 ms.

records.context: So both go through a :class:`~spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` owned by the editor, and the value reads are additionally debounced. Three rules hold this together:

records.context: :class:`TrellisCanvas` **subclasses** :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` rather than reimplementing it. The mark drawing, the fixed categorical hue order, the density raster, the selection ring, the legend and the brush are one implementation, and a second one would be a second set of rules to keep in step with the first — the mistake :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` avoids by not drawing anything at all.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

The mark drawing, the fixed categorical hue order, the density raster, the selection ring, the legend and the brush are one implementation, and a second one would be a second set of rules to keep in step with the first — the mistake :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` avoids by not drawing anything at all.
records.translation: :class:`TrellisCanvas` **erfir** :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` í stað þess að útfæra hann aftur. Teiknun merkja, fasta litaröð flokka, þéttleikarastrið, valhringurinn, skýringartextinn og penslunin eru ein útfærsla, og önnur væri annað reglusafn sem þyrfti að halda í takti við það fyrra — mistökin sem :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` forðast með því að teikna alls ekki neitt.

records.source: **the layout** comes from :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.trellis`, which knows about wrapping and about blank slots, rather than from ``facet_grid`` directly;
records.translation: **útlitið** kemur úr :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.trellis`, sem kann skil á línuskiptingu og auðum hólfum, en ekki beint úr ``facet_grid``;

records.context: **the scales are set per panel from that panel's own group**. Every panel's limits are written explicitly rather than left to matplotlib's ``sharex``: sharing makes panels agree with *each other*, but on whatever the first one autoscaled to, which is not necessarily wide enough for the rest. Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.

Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.
records.translation: **kvarðarnir eru stilltir fyrir hvert spjald út frá eigin hópi þess**. Mörk hvers spjalds eru skrifuð beint í stað þess að vera látin eftir ``sharex`` matplotlib: samnýting lætur spjöldin vera sammála *hvert öðru*, en um það sem fyrsta spjaldið kvarðaðist sjálfkrafa í, sem er ekki endilega nógu vítt fyrir hin. Undir :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — sjálfgefnu stillingunni — fær hvert spjald nákvæmlega sömu tvennd, sem er eiginleiki sem prófun getur staðfest og auga getur treyst.

records.source: ``payload['frame']`` is optional: a DataFrame with one row per point, carrying whatever the caller measured. Without it the explorer can still identify its points (from the records' ``prcfo``) and so still publishes and receives selections — but a filter on a measurement column has nothing here to test, and is reported as ignored rather than silently drawing everything as if it had applied.
records.translation: ``payload['frame']`` er valkvætt: DataFrame með einni línu á punkt, sem ber hvað sem sá sem kallar mældi. Án þess getur skoðarinn samt borið kennsl á punkta sína (úr ``prcfo`` færslnanna) og birtir því og tekur enn við vali — en sía á mælingadálki hefur ekkert hér til að prófa, og er tilkynnt sem hunsuð í stað þess að allt sé teiknað í kyrrþey eins og henni hefði verið beitt.
